records.title_en: Strong Winds and Rough Seas Warning
records.summary_en: Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds over waters of East Johor and Northern Sarawak; winds up to 50 km/h, waves up to 3.5 m.

Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds over Johor (Kota Tinggi) and Sabah (Membakut, Beaufort, Kuala Penyu, Papar, Penampang, Putatan, Kota Kinabalu, Tuaran, Kota Belud, Semporna, Lahad Datu, Kunak) until 2:00 PM.
No tropical cyclone observed in MMD monitoring region.
